sources.title: July 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
June 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts

candidates.name: July management total built premises
candidates.gate: Management snapshot; not exact current parcel availability.

candidates.name: June-to-July built-premises change
candidates.gate: Ingestion timing and administrative revisions prevent delivery-performance scoring.

candidates.name: June-to-July contracted-premises change
candidates.gate: Initial-scope changes must not be interpreted as coverage loss.

candidates.name: CO8 Cheshire zero-built observation
candidates.gate: Snapshot value; no milestone or parcel inference.

candidates.name: Central Cornwall initial-scope completion ratio
candidates.gate: Initial contract scope only; deferred scope may be absent.

candidates.name: GBVS maximum voucher
candidates.gate: Eligibility and supplier project approval still required.

candidates.name: GBVS multi-premise requirement
candidates.gate: Single connections are not eligible.

candidates.name: GBVS speed-uplift requirement
candidates.value: 2× below 50 Mbps; at least 100 Mbps above 50 Mbps
candidates.gate: Scheme qualification rule, not evidence of delivered service.

candidates.name: Local-authority robustness boundary
candidates.value: average speeds robust to local-authority level, not postcode
candidates.gate: Do not infer exact postcode or parcel performance.

candidates.name: Postcode performance-file discontinuity
candidates.gate: Avoid filling postcode performance gaps from area averages.

candidates.name: Fixed/mobile dataset separation
candidates.gate: Cross-domain joins require aligned geography and dates.

candidates.name: Year-on-year infrastructure comparison
candidates.gate: Methodology changes must be reconciled before trend scoring.

candidates.name: Project Gigabit 2032 target
candidates.gate: Target must not be treated as delivered coverage.

candidates.name: Project Gigabit baseline cost
candidates.gate: Budget scale is not parcel availability.

candidates.name: Project Gigabit delivery confidence
candidates.gate: Programme assessment cannot score individual premises.

candidates.name: Shared Rural Network landmass objective
candidates.gate: Geographic coverage differs from premises and indoor coverage.

candidates.name: Shared Rural Network reported reach
candidates.gate: Programme aggregate; exact local availability requires coverage data.

candidates.name: Shared Rural Network remaining obligations
candidates.gate: Future legal deadline is not completed coverage.

candidates.name: Exact UPRN promotion requirement
candidates.value: source package + content hash + exact UPRN join
candidates.gate: Canonical parcel promotion remains blocked.

candidates.name: Single-runner recovery gate
candidates.gate: Evidence-only work cannot replace canonical execution.
